name: Reconstruction Error (RE) Metric
definition: An L2 norm-based metric quantifying the pixel-wise discrepancy between a rendered image and a ground truth target image, used to evaluate geometry and material reconstruction accuracy.
summary: The Reconstruction Error metric quantifies pixel-wise photometric fidelity between rendered and ground truth images using the L2 norm, distinguishing itself by measuring direct geometric accuracy rather than temporal or perceptual qualities.
